text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Here we finally are at the stage of my
showdown
against the Mejiro family—the
Hanshin Juvenile
Fillies!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What kind of advantages do you get
when you're
born into a family? None!
That's right, we're all
equal in the grand
scheme of things!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Even if the divine dares to claim that
differences
in the environment one is
raised in leads to
differences in
strength...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I choose to staunchly disagree! So here I go, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl turns away from me
and heads
toward the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Pearl, you're here. Here's to a good race
today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
As a representative of the Mejiro family,
I vow to
perform better than you.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I see you've come shouldering the
familial bonds
of your house, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But you aren't the only one—I have my
own bonds
as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You do? That's a bit surprising.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Well, they're a work in progress, so I'm
not
surprised you haven't noticed.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But mark my words! My bonds will only
grow
stronger from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The connections I share... are with all the
people I
don't know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You aren't limited to only forming bonds with people in your family. Just because you were born with a set of powerful connections...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't mean you can't create new ones
with
other people! And those bonds can
become even
stronger than your existing
ones!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
In today's race, I'm going to prove to
you that
when it comes to our running,
the playing field is
completely level.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Pearl...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's bold... I don't know any other
Umamusume
who thinks like that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But that's all the more reason why I must
do
better than you here at the final race
of our junior
year!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Sounds good! Bring it on, Dober! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Family doesn't need to be so narrowly
defined.
Holding this belief close to her
heart, Seeking the
Pearl takes on the
Hanshin Juvenile Fillies.
